verdict.rationale: Apify's own site says the platform works with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and Scrapy, alongside its own Crawlee library. Supporting docs cover developing your own Actors, base Docker images, and moving existing projects onto the platform. missing for 10: in-depth per-library setup or integration docs (e.g. Scrapy or Selenium templates and guides), independent or hands-on corroboration of building with each library.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy

citations.quote: Apify works great with both Python and JavaScript, as well as Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy, and Crawlee - our own web crawling and browser automation library.
